nodes.name: Priya inventories stage props
nodes.description: Priya methodically checks the stage props against her tablet, showing she is managing prop security and readiness.
evidence: Priya moves efficiently between prop tables, inventorying items on her tablet.

nodes.name: Priya secures prop pistol
nodes.description: Priya checks the silver-painted prop pistol, stores it in the prop cabinet, and carefully padlocks the cabinet.
evidence: She lifts a SILVER-PAINTED PROP PISTOL from the table, checks it against her list, and places it in the prop cabinet.
She closes the cabinet and secures it with a PADLOCK, spinning the dial three full rotations before engaging the lock.

nodes.name: Leon questions inventory routine
nodes.description: Leon approaches Priya and asks whether she is doing the full inventory that night.
evidence:
LEON
Doing the full inventory tonight?
Leon approaches, watching.

nodes.name: Priya emphasizes strict prop security
nodes.description: Priya states that with opening night near, she is ensuring nothing goes missing by keeping the props padlocked.
evidence:
PRIYA
Padlocked. Done. This close to opening night, nothing walks off.

nodes.name: Priya realizes Leon wants rehearsal
nodes.description: Priya correctly identifies that Leon wants to practice the pistol scene.
evidence: A pause. Priya gives him a look.

PRIYA
You want to run the pistol scene.

nodes.name: Leon requests draw practice
nodes.description: Leon asks to rehearse only the draw because the cast makes the movement feel unnatural.
evidence:
LEON
Just the draw. The cast makes the motion feel strange.

nodes.name: Priya allows brief rehearsal
nodes.description: Despite her hesitation, Priya agrees to give Leon five minutes to practice.
evidence:
PRIYA
(sighing)
Five minutes.

nodes.name: Priya unlocks cabinet and hands over pistol
aliases: Priya unlocks cabinet and hands over pistol
nodes.description: Priya opens the padlock, retrieves the prop pistol, and gives it to Leon for the rehearsal.
evidence: She opens the padlock, retrieves the silver prop pistol, and hands it to Leon.

nodes.name: Leon rehearses pistol draw
nodes.description: Leon takes position, recites the line, and executes the draw smoothly despite his arm being in a cast.
evidence: He stands in position, right hand raising the pistol smoothly.

LEON
The line is: "Put it down before one of us stops breathing." Then the draw.
He moves through it. Power there, even with the left arm in the cast.

nodes.name: Priya approves Leon's performance
nodes.description: Priya acknowledges that Leon's rehearsal works effectively.
evidence:
PRIYA
That actually works.

nodes.name: Leon says he informed Diana
nodes.description: Leon states that he already told Diana about his ability to perform the draw.
evidence:
LEON
I told Diana.

nodes.name: Priya relocks pistol and demands secrecy
aliases: Priya relocks pistol and demands secrecy
nodes.description: Priya takes back the prop pistol, locks it away again, and tells Leon not to reveal that she let him practice without a spotter.
evidence:
PRIYA
Don't tell anyone I let you practice without a spotter.
Priya takes the pistol, returns it to the cabinet, and locks the padlock again with three spins.
